source.review: C1-03 wave 2 — control spells: one saving throw at cast, a condition on failure, tracked for the spell's duration. Repeat saves, escape checks, area drift and speech-dependent nuances are recorded in each executionScope and left to the DM.

primary.summary: 실패한 크리처는 거미줄에 걸려 포박 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot cube when the webs appear make a DEX save; on a failure they are Restrained while the caster concentrates. Escaping with a STR check, the difficult terrain, the webs burning (2d4 fire) and the anchoring rule are not enforced.

primary.summary: 실패한 크리처는 식물에 붙들려 포박 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot square when the plants appear make a STR save; on a failure they are Restrained while the caster concentrates. The difficult terrain and escaping with a STR check are not enforced.

primary.summary: 실패한 크리처는 미끄러져 넘어짐 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 10-foot square when the grease appears make a DEX save; on a failure they fall Prone. The one-minute difficult terrain and the save for creatures entering later are not enforced.

primary.summary: 실패한 크리처는 구름 속에서 구토하며 중독 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot-radius sphere make a CON save; on a failure they are Poisoned (the SRD's incapacitating retching) while the caster concentrates. The heavily obscured area and the repeat save each turn are not enforced.

primary.summary: 실패한 크리처는 얼어붙은 바닥에서 넘어짐 상태가 된다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 40-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius cylinder make a DEX save; on a failure they fall Prone. The heavily obscured, difficult terrain, the concentration check for casters inside, and the repeat save for creatures entering later are not enforced.

primary.summary: 실패한 대상은 매혹 상태로 암시된 행동 방침을 따른다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): the target makes a WIS save; on a failure it is Charmed and follows the suggestion while the caster concentrates (up to 8 hours). The suggestion's wording, its completion ending the spell, and damage ending it are left to the DM.

primary.summary: 실패한 대상들은 매혹 상태로 암시된 행동 방침을 따른다.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): up to twelve targets make a WIS save; on a failure they are Charmed and follow the suggestion for 24 hours. The longer durations for higher slots and damage ending the spell are not enforced.
